raw_context:
Watsons
is Asia's leading health, beauty, and pharmacy chain store. Known for
its extensive O+O (offline plus online) retail network
spanning over 8,000 stores across 16 markets, the brand offers cosmetics, personal care items, pharmaceuticals, and an affordable private-label product line.
AS Watson Group
Core Offerings and Identity
Health and Beauty Retail:
Stocking thousands of skincare, cosmetics, hair care, and wellness items.
In-Store Pharmacies:
Providing licensed pharmacy counters and professional health counseling.
Private Label Range:
Selling budget-friendly, high-quality consumer goods under the direct Watsons brand name (such as skincare, tissues, and toiletries).
O+O Strategy:
Combining physical neighborhood and mall storefronts with seamless digital apps and e-commerce delivery.
